sloka: भूय एव महातेजा हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ।अब्रवीत् प्रश्रितं वाक्यं सीताप्रत्ययकारणात् ।। ५.३६.१।।।।
transliteration: bhūya eva mahātejā hanumān mārutātmajaḥ ।abravīt praśritaṁ vākyaṁ sītāpratyayakāraṇāt ।। 5.36.1।।।।

translations.english: Mighty Hanuman, the son of the Windgod again spoke to Sita humbly to inspire confidence in her.
